prompts.prompt: Make a snack selector field. Users can choose Apple, Banana, or Orange, but there should also be an Other option that reveals a text input for a custom snack before applying it.
Build a media gallery that mixes images and videos. Clicking any item opens a lightbox viewer. Videos should show native playback controls. Images should support zoom on double-click.
Build a checkout flow: cart summary → shipping → payment → confirmation
Like Notion's page header with icon picker and cover image
Build a file upload component that shows a progress bar during upload. Display the filename, file size, and percentage complete. Show a success state when done.

Show a content library table where each row has a small colored pill for its type — Article, Video, Podcast, Newsletter, and Course each need their own distinct color so they're easy to tell apart at a glance. The colors should stay consistent everywhere a type appears.
A sidebar that becomes a bottom sheet on mobile
A file upload button that shows progress and calls an upload endpoint
Create a product detail page with breadcrumb navigation showing Home > Category > Subcategory > Product Name. The page should have a header, product info section, and a back button.
Create a blog post header with a big editorial headline, a publication date in small text, and an author name
